methodSource.says: How to Measure Clothing, Tops: "C. Body Length: The length in the back of the garment in the center to the bottom (hem)." (read 2026-10-10 for Fynd's other UNIQLO records; UNIQLO's general instructions for tops). The product table labels it "Length (back)".

How to Measure Clothing, Tops: "A. Shoulder Width: The length between the broadest part of the shoulders." (read 2026-10-10). The supplied table header says only "Shoulder width", not "seam to seam", so it is not recorded as seam to seam.

derivedCircumference.derivation: UNIQLO's measuring instructions give this as a flat width, armpit to armpit, not a circumference. Where Fynd needs the garment's chest around, it takes 2 × the published flat width and labels the result estimated: it assumes the front and back are the same width and ignores fabric give. The derived value is never stored here, and it is never compared with UNIQLO's body chest ranges, which are a separate chart.

methodSource.says: How to Measure Clothing, Tops: "B. Body Width: The length from armpit to armpit." (read 2026-10-10). The product table labels this column only "Chest"; its values (24 3/4 in for M, below M's 37 3/4 - 41 in body chest) cannot be a circumference.

notes: Product Size only. UNIQLO's Body Size tab for this product has not been recorded here; Fynd shows UNIQLO's general US men's tops body chart beside it, labelled as general (api/_sizing/official-charts/uniqlo-us-men-tops-body.json).
Values are kept exactly as supplied ("25 1/4"), in inches; the size guide link names measurementUnit=inch.
"Chest" is recorded as a flat width armpit to armpit on UNIQLO's general measuring instructions, as for Fynd's other UNIQLO records; the table itself doesn't say so.

"Shoulder width" is recorded by UNIQLO's own instruction (the broadest part of the shoulders), not as seam to seam: the supplied header doesn't say seam to seam, so it is never compared with a shoulder measured seam to seam.
Fit is from the product's name ("Oversized") only; Fynd has not read its product details or materials.

Fynd's catalogue lists this product under men's (from a "Men's Sweat Oversized Pullover Hoodie" listing title); some UNIQLO US titles for it read "Unisex". Its sizes follow the men's scale either way.
